mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower financing costs for corporate expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.25% for two consecutive months, it triggers aggressive monetary stimulus that rapidly boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and rise in unemployment rate signals monetary policy response to labor market deterioration, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as investors anticipate further stimulus.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises in the same month
regime_hint: monetary policy response to labor weakness
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) triggers Federal Reserve monetary easing that accelerates S&P 500 rebound over 60 days as economic support measures boost corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that correlate with rising corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases for 6 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 750,000 units signals robust consumer confidence and economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days through accelerated retail and construction sector growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 750.0 units.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates synchronized demand and supply expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises and INDPRO rises in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO rise in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) signals manufacturing contraction and recessionary pressures, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95.0.
